# Howl

> Multi-driver Laravel notifier (Discord, Slack, Telegram) with rich embeds, channel failover, and queue-aware dispatch. PHP 8.3+, Laravel 12/13.

## Quick Start
- [Installation](https://howl.skaisser.dev/v1.0.0/guide/installation): composer require, env setup
- [Quick Start](https://howl.skaisser.dev/v1.0.0/guide/quick-start): 5-minute walkthrough

## Drivers
- [Discord](https://howl.skaisser.dev/v1.0.0/drivers/discord): webhook + thread routing
- [Slack](https://howl.skaisser.dev/v1.0.0/drivers/slack): Block Kit + bot OAuth
- [Telegram](https://howl.skaisser.dev/v1.0.0/drivers/telegram): HTML + Forum topics

## Configuration
- [Reference](https://howl.skaisser.dev/v1.0.0/configuration/reference): every config key documented
- [Channel routing](https://howl.skaisser.dev/v1.0.0/configuration/channel-routing): per-call, event-level, config precedence
- [Failover & fan-out](https://howl.skaisser.dev/v1.0.0/configuration/failover-and-fan-out): automatic backup channel dispatch
- [Rate limiting](https://howl.skaisser.dev/v1.0.0/configuration/rate-limiting): Redis-backed opt-in throttling

## Events, Testing, Extension
- [Event contract](https://howl.skaisser.dev/v1.0.0/events/contract): HowlEvent abstract base + 8-method contract
- [Built-in events](https://howl.skaisser.dev/v1.0.0/events/built-in): 7 production-ready event templates
- [Custom events](https://howl.skaisser.dev/v1.0.0/events/custom): extend HowlEvent for domain events
- [HowlFake testing](https://howl.skaisser.dev/v1.0.0/testing/howl-fake): first-class test assertions without real HTTP
- [Architecture tests](https://howl.skaisser.dev/v1.0.0/testing/architecture): Pest arch() structural enforcement
- [Custom drivers](https://howl.skaisser.dev/v1.0.0/extension/custom-driver): implement Driver contract for any service
- [Builder methods](https://howl.skaisser.dev/v1.0.0/extension/builder-methods): full PendingNotification fluent API
- [Queue & rate limit](https://howl.skaisser.dev/v1.0.0/extension/queue-and-rate-limit): async dispatch + SendHowlJob

## Reference
- [API reference](https://howl.skaisser.dev/v1.0.0/reference/api): Howl facade, PendingNotification, Payload, Driver contract

## Upgrade
- [Upgrade Guide v0.x → v1.0](https://howl.skaisser.dev/v1.0.0/upgrade): migration codemod + breaking changes + new env vars
- [Release Notes](https://howl.skaisser.dev/v1.0.0/releases): what's new in v1.0.0
